title: Structural interplay between DNA-shape protein recognition and supercoiling: the case of IHF
authors: George D. Watson; Elliot W. Chan; Mark C. Leake; Agnes Noy
one_liner_zh: 该文通过原子级分子动力学模拟研究IHF蛋白与超螺旋DNA的互作，揭示DNA弯曲蛋白与拓扑应力间的双向调控机制，属于蛋白质-DNA互作动态机理的物理模拟研究，虽非典型TF-DNA体系但方法高度可迁移。
abstract: The integration host factor (IHF) is a prominent example of indirect readout as it imposes one of the strongest bends on relaxed linear DNA. However, the relation between IHF and torsionally constrained DNA, as occurs physiologically, remains unclear. By using atomistic molecular dynamics simulations on DNA minicircles, we reveal, for the first time, the reciprocal influence between a DNA-bending protein and supercoiling. While the increased curvature of supercoiled DNA enhances wrapping around IHF, the protein pins the position of plectonemes, organizing the topology of the loop in a unique and specific manner. In addition, IHF restrains underor overtwisted DNA depending on whether the complex is formed in negatively or positively supercoiled DNA. This effectively enables IHF to become a ‘supercoiling buffer’ that dampens changes in the surrounding superhelical stress through DNA breathing around the protein or complex dissociation. We finally provide evidence of DNA bridging by IHF and reveal that these bridges divide DNA into independent topological domains. We anticipate that the crosstalk detected here between the ‘active’ DNA and the multifaceted IHF could be common to other DNA-protein complexes relying on the deformation of DNA.
abstract_zh: 整合宿主因子（IHF）是间接读取的一个突出例子，因为它对松弛线性DNA施加了最强的弯曲之一。然而，IHF与扭转约束DNA（如生理条件下所发生的）之间的关系仍不清楚。通过对DNA微环进行原子级分子动力学模拟，我们首次揭示了DNA弯曲蛋白与超螺旋之间的相互影响。超螺旋DNA增加的曲率增强了围绕IHF的缠绕，而该蛋白则固定了螺旋桨（plectoneme）的位置，以独特且特异的方式组织环的拓扑结构。此外，IHF根据复合物是在负超螺旋还是正超螺旋DNA中形成，分别限制欠扭转或过扭转的DNA。这有效地使IHF成为“超螺旋缓冲器”，通过蛋白质周围的DNA呼吸或复合物解离来缓冲周围超螺旋应力的变化。我们最终提供了IHF桥接DNA的证据，并揭示这些桥将DNA划分为独立的拓扑结构域。我们预计，此处检测到的“活性”DNA与多面性IHF之间的串扰可能在其他依赖DNA变形的DNA-蛋白质复合物中普遍存在。
